sources.support: KnowBe4 says it hired a principal software engineer using a valid stolen U.S. identity. Four video interviews and background checks passed; the company says Mandiant and the FBI corroborated its DPRK assessment. EDR alerted when the new Mac began suspicious activity on July 15, 2024. KnowBe4 says no illegal access, data loss, compromise, or exfiltration occurred
sources.locator: Incident Report Summary; July 15 timeline; stock-photo/AI comparison

sources.support: KnowBe4 clarifies that it was not breached; the worker had no access to customer data, private networks, cloud infrastructure, code, confidential information, or the KnowBe4 platform; the reviewed user account accessed nothing beyond its own email inbox; the attempted malware was blocked and did not execute; and the laptop was quarantined within minutes. The FAQ is a companion clarification to the July 23 incident disclosure, not independent corroboration
